# Software-identity fixtures

Small synthetic files for the `software` adapter (`neptune.adapters.software`, ADR 0040),
generated byte for byte by `make_software_fixtures.py` (run it after changing one; `--check` asks
installed official readers, `readelf`, `onnx` and `safetensors`, to read them back). No real
weights, no clock, no `git` at run time. `setup_py` files have no `.py` suffix so the linters and
type checker never read them as code; a git directory cannot be committed inside a repository,
so `git/` holds its files under plain names and the job tests build a `.git` tree from them.

| File | Case | The adapter must |
|---|---|---|
| `git/HEAD` | symbolic ref | emit no record; `git_symbolic_ref` naming `refs/heads/main` |
| `git/HEAD_detached`, `git/ORIG_HEAD` | object name | one item, `commit` citing the 40 hex digits |
| `git/packed-refs` | header with `peeled`, an annotated tag and its `^` line | an item per ref; the tag's commit is the peeled one |
| `git/packed-refs_unpeeled` | pre-1.6 file, no header | the tag's commit `Unknown` plus `git_unpeeled_tag` |
| `git/packed-refs_corrupt` | a bad line, a truncated last line | `malformed_entry` for each; the good ref is read |
| `git/release.sha256` | one hex line named like a checksum | not claimed when probed by that name |
| `manifests/package.xml` | ROS REP 149 manifest | name and SemVer release citing their elements |
| `manifests/package_bad_version.xml` | `2.1` | declared text plus `version_not_semver` |
| `manifests/package_entity.xml` | entity declarations | `malformed`, never expanded |
| `manifests/package_truncated.xml` | cut inside the document | `malformed` |
| `manifests/pyproject.toml` | PEP 621 | name and declared release by JSON pointer |
| `manifests/pyproject_dynamic.toml` | `dynamic = ["version"]` | release `Unknown` plus `unevaluated` |
| `manifests/pyproject_conflict.toml` | `[project]` and `[tool.poetry]` disagree | release `Ambiguous` plus `conflicting_identity` |
| `manifests/Cargo.toml`, `Cargo_member.toml`, `Cargo_workspace.toml` | package, inherited version, workspace only | SemVer; `unevaluated`; not claimed |
| `manifests/CMakeLists.txt` | `project()` over lines, a comment with `(` | name and release citing their arguments |
| `manifests/CMakeLists_variable.txt`, `_unterminated.txt` | `${...}`; an open quote | `unevaluated`; `malformed` |
| `manifests/setup_py`, `setup_dynamic_py`, `setup_broken_py` | literals; a call; a syntax error | literals cited; `unevaluated`; `malformed` |
| `lockfiles/uv.lock`, `poetry.lock`, `Cargo.lock` | registry, editable and git packages | an item each; git commits as spans; the editable root `software_identity_missing` |
| `lockfiles/uv_truncated.lock`, `Cargo_bad.lock` | cut mid-table; a non-SemVer version | `malformed`; `version_not_semver` |
| `lockfiles/package-lock.json`, `package-lock_v1.json` | npm v3 with a link and a git dep; v1 nested | links skipped; nested deps in pre-order |
| `lockfiles/package-lock_duplicate.json` | a repeated key | `malformed`, never the last value |
| `firmware/app.elf` | ELF64 LE, build-id and FDO package notes | build id, name and release |
| `firmware/app32be.elf` | ELF32 BE, note in a program header only | the build id through `PT_NOTE` |
| `firmware/stripped.elf`, `truncated.elf`, `object.o` | no notes; cut in its section table; relocatable | `software_identity_missing`; `truncated`; not claimed |
| `firmware/esp_app.bin`, `esp_truncated.bin` | ESP-IDF app descriptor; cut | name, firmware release, ELF hash; `truncated` |
| `firmware/mcuboot.bin`, `mcuboot_truncated.bin` | MCUboot 1.4.0+12; image cut short | release; `truncated` beside the record |
| `firmware/firmware.px4`, `firmware.apj` | PX4 (`git_hash`, describe) and ArduPilot (abbreviated hash) | board, commit, release |
| `checkpoints/policy.safetensors` | two tensors of zeros | one item, all `NotCovered` |
| `checkpoints/policy_truncated.safetensors`, `_bad_header` | data cut; header past the end | `truncated` |
| `checkpoints/policy.onnx`, `_noversion`, `_truncated` | `model_version` 3; none; cut in the graph | release; `software_identity_missing`; `truncated` |
| `checkpoints/policy.pt`, `policy_truncated.pt` | `torch.save` zip layout; directory cut | one item; `truncated` |
| `sbom/robot.cdx.json` | CycloneDX 1.5: model hash, oci purl, firmware, nested, unpinned | digests and kinds per component |
| `sbom/robot.spdx.json` | SPDX 2.3: docker purl, firmware, `NOASSERTION` | digest span; firmware release; `Unknown` |
| `sbom/index.json`, `index_bad_digest.json` | OCI image index; an `md5:` digest | digests; `invalid_value` |
| `sbom/duplicate.cdx.json` | a repeated key | `malformed` |
